before: cancelJob(id){const j=this.s.jobs.find(j=>j.id===id);if(!j)return this.result(false,'This task has already finished');for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(j.cost||{}))this.gain({[k]:v*(j.kind==='op'?.25:.5)});const a=this.s.craft.find(a=>a.id===j.asset);if(a)a.busy=null;this.s.jobs=this.s.jobs.filter(x=>x.id!==id);return this.result(true,'Task canceled. Recoverable resources returned.');}
after: cancelJob(id){const j=this.s.jobs.find(j=>j.id===id);if(!j)return this.result(false,'This task has already finished');for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(j.cost||{}))this.gain({[k]:v*(j.kind==='op'?.25:.5)});const a=this.s.craft.find(a=>a.id===j.asset);if(a)a.busy=null;const agent=this.s.agents.find(x=>x.id===j.agent);if(agent)agent.busy=null;this.s.jobs=this.s.jobs.filter(x=>x.id!==id);return this.result(true,'Task canceled. Recoverable resources returned.');}

before: eventView(){const e=this.s.eventQueue[0];if(!e)return null;let d=EVENTS[e.id],c=this.country(e.context.country);let title=d.title,body=d.body;if(e.context.echo&&d.echo){title=d.echo.title;body=d.echo.body;}return {...d,...e,title,body:body.replaceAll('{country}',c?.name||'the region'),choices:d.choices.map(ch=>{const cost=ch.cost||{},blocked=[...this.shortages(cost)];if(ch.requires==='recovery'&&!this.s.craft.some(a=>a.type==='recovery'||a.type==='platform'))blocked.push('No recovery-capable craft');if(ch.requires==='contact'&&(c?.contact||0)<2)blocked.push('Requires a backchannel');return {...ch,blocked};})};}

after: if(j.kind==='project'){s.projectReady=j.subtype;s.speed=0;this.notice('Final project ready. Choose your future in the Future panel.');if(!this.projectConditions(j.subtype).every(c=>c.ok))this.raise('final_conditions');}
